definitions.fold_local_selection: highest recorded best_inner_f1, then best_inner_mcc, then recorded model order
definitions.baseline_replay: recorded family and best_params, source-only full fit, SMOTE k=1, threshold 0.5
definitions.duplicate_handling: only exact exported-row duplicates are removed before modeling; no metric-tuple deduplication
definitions.recall_at_20pct_entities: positive recall in ceil(20% of target rows) ranked by descending probability with sample_id tie-break
definitions.loc_recall_at_20pct_effort: positive recall in the smallest ranked prefix reaching at least 20% of nonnegative total_nloc/nloc effort
definitions.aucec: trapezoidal area under cumulative positive recall versus cumulative nonnegative LOC-effort fraction
definitions.temporal_reference: first 80% versus final 20% mapped unique SHAs ordered by timestamp and SHA; LOPO and WPDP share late test rows
definitions.mean_feature_shift: mean absolute target-source feature-mean difference in source-standard-deviation units after source-median imputation
definitions.harmonized_sensitivity: fixed-family/fixed-hyperparameter replay with aligned NLOC, token-count, and complexity descriptors only; residual confounding remains
definitions.conflict_cleaning: post-hoc removal from both classes of every identity key exported in both labels
definitions.causal_claims: none; transfer-boundary, feature-correlation, harmonized, and conflict-cleaning results are exploratory/descriptive
